text: The behaviour oracle for refactors is a differential sweep plus a create benchmark, both local and untracked under tmp-claude/2026-11-02-refactor-survey/: construct/sweep.sh runs ~7400 CLI invocations over every fixture, memory mode and flag against an old and a new binary and diffs stdout, exit codes and .sufr bytes; construct/bench.sh times create on synth.fa (50 MB DNA) and bytes.fa, 4 threads, interleaved runs. Baseline at 6df218d: create --dna --write-lcp ~2.45 s, peak RSS ~124 MB.
